config.dcsharp.category.gameplay.immersi: Settings to improve vehicle handling and reduce slippery driving feel for Immersive Vehicles.

The hard ceiling for the oversteer multiplier. Lowering this makes vehicles more stable at high speeds.
Default: 2.5

Determines how quickly velocity ramps up the oversteer force. Increasing this number means the vehicle has to be moving much faster before it starts spinning out.
Default: 4.0

Multiplier that increases the friction of all wheels to prevent sliding.
Default: 1.5

The minimum friction a tire can have, increasing this above 0 will prevent complete slipping regardless of ground / tire materials.
Default: 0.5

Multiplier for how far the wheels turn per input. Reducing makes inputs less twitchy but requires longer inputs for sharper turns.
Default: 30.0

Controls how the game limits the size of turning circles when driving fast. A higher number restricts sharper turns at top speeds.
Default: 0.5
